basis.scope: Engineering-record content only. Supplied scenario facts are fixtures. No product, deployment, recovery, implementation or test behavior was observed.
basis.word_count_method: The frozen word-bound checks use whitespace-delimited words in the complete UTF-8 Markdown, including headings, tables and markup. A separate lexical count of Unicode word-character runs is reported for transparency. Neither count represents model token usage; exact model token telemetry is unavailable. Both counts satisfy the bounds.

status_meanings.PASS: The inspected authored content satisfies the stated documentation criterion.
status_meanings.FAIL: A located defect contradicts a stated documentation criterion.
status_meanings.UNVERIFIED: Available evidence does not establish the claimed behavior or delivery property.

cases.status_scope: The supplied change-record content against the frozen documentation criteria; product acceptance remains unverified.

checks.criterion: Record identity, purpose, scope, revision/baseline and actual ownership/review state

evidence.finding: CR-F01 identifies the correction, revision/date, draft/unapproved status, one-button scope and supplied baseline. Owner and reviewer are explicitly UNASSIGNED.

checks.criterion: Distinguish supplied sources, assumptions/proposals and actual execution evidence

evidence.finding: Links the F01 fixture, labels the double-submit observation as reported and reproduction UNVERIFIED, and states that research/measurements are unavailable.
Requirements distinguish supplied constraints from proposed accessible-feedback acceptance; DEC-F01-01 is expressly proposed.
Identifies API-contract limitations and unavailable artifacts; both planned tests are Not run / UNVERIFIED and no approval is granted.

checks.criterion: Stable requirement, decision and verification trace to source and proposed correction

evidence.finding: The fixture source, OBS-F01-01, REQ-F01-01 through REQ-F01-03 and DEC-F01-01 give stable local references. The decision describes the shared pending-operation guard for the duplicate-mutation requirement.
TEST-F01-01 and TEST-F01-02 explicitly map to requirement IDs, with planned methods, expected observations and actual status.

checks.criterion: Verifiable duplicate-effect requirement preserves native semantics and brand

evidence.finding: Requires no additional mutation while pending, preservation of native button/form semantics and existing brand, and accessible status/keyboard/focus behavior.

Proposes synchronous ownership at the mutation entry boundary, shared activation/submit paths, operation-specific release, reuse of the native control and existing visual tokens, and explicit limits on local suppression.
Plans pending rapid-click, keyboard and form-submission observation plus pending/success/failure semantics, brand and accessibility inspection.

checks.criterion: Professional proportional record without unnecessary documents or approval ceremony

evidence.finding: One concise, self-contained engineering change record contains the sources, requirements, proposal, rationale, limits and planned acceptance evidence. No separate SRS, ADR or runbook is requested.
Briefly compares a shared guard with visual-only state and separate flags, and defines a reconsideration condition proportionate to the small change.
Actual unapproved/unassigned state is recorded without adding a permission step.

checks.criterion: No invented implementation, test, build, approval, research, numeric target or normative conformance

evidence.finding: Unavailable implementation/build, measurements, API contract and test evidence are stated explicitly. No performance target, user research, standards clause, mandatory document format or standards-conformance claim appears.

unverified.subject: Reported double submission and acceptance behavior
unverified.evidence: Lines 12 and 32-39 explicitly state no reproduction, implementation or executed tests.

unverified.subject: Exclusive one-file filesystem delivery
unverified.evidence: Only the assigned artifact was inspected; directory inventory was outside the four-file read scope. The inspected content itself is a single self-contained record.

limitations: Stable trace is documentary. No implementation/build artifact exists to demonstrate that the proposed guard or native/accessibility behavior is implemented.
Browser/device coverage and API timeout/reconciliation contracts remain explicitly unknown. Their absence is honestly recorded rather than treated as acceptance evidence.

cases.status_scope: The supplied design-and-operation-record content against the frozen documentation criteria; operating acceptance remains unverified.

checks.criterion: Record identity, purpose, revision/baseline, stakeholders and actual ownership/review state

evidence.finding: F02 identifies the staging API/compute subject, revision/date, Platform team owner, unassigned reviewer, proposal/no-approval state, operator/maintainer audience and supplied-scenario baseline.
Tenants, API/integration responsibilities, Platform authority and site authority are represented with their identity, execution, isolation, deployment and recovery concerns.

checks.criterion: Supplied facts, proposal and actual evidence distinguished; no invented execution or conformance

evidence.finding: Labels environment facts as supplied fixtures and identifies unknown installed versions, resources, code, capacity and recovery prerequisites.
The decision, transactional authority design and deployment are proposals; managed resources remain unselected and regional/capacity guarantees unverified.
Declares placeholders UNREADY, states no commands were run, and records no deployment, build, tests or measured recovery. No normative clause, required standards format or conformance claim appears.

checks.criterion: Stable requirements/decision/verification trace to sources and proposed artifacts

evidence.finding: The F02 fixture is linked; R01-R05 retain job acceptance, tenant isolation, publication replay, recovery target and staging/site constraints, each linked to V01-V05.
D01 explicitly supports R01-R05. V01-V05 map respectively to those requirements through D01 and this revision, with planned probes, expected outcomes and actual evidence state.
Pinned artifacts, immutable image/configuration identity and target-plan inspection are required before proposed deployment; no nonexistent artifact is represented as available.

checks.criterion: Boundaries, relationships, state ownership, authority, deployment and failure views

evidence.finding: Gives an end-to-end tenant/API/ledger/outbox/queue/bridge/login/Slurm/solver relationship and distinguishes API job identity/authorization from Slurm allocation/execution. Login-host duties exclude solver execution.
Defines durable commit before acceptance, tenant/scheduler identity binding, replay reconciliation, per-tenant site identity/ACL authority and fenced conditional final-manifest publication.

Proposes private API/bridge placement and controlled ingress, allocates Platform versus site responsibility, and identifies WAN, site/storage, stale-state and unknown-submission failures with dispatch restrictions.

checks.criterion: Alternatives, tradeoffs, justified decision and reconsideration tied to constraints

evidence.finding: Retaining Slurm/Apptainer follows the preserve-Slurm constraint. Kubernetes replacement is compared through migration and unproven compute/storage/scheduling suitability; retention benefits and WAN/site/queue dependencies are explicit. Reconsideration requires changed constraints and representative measured benefit.

checks.criterion: Ordered bounded procedure with trust/environment prerequisites, target, expected outcomes, stop and recovery conditions; placeholders are not execution

evidence.finding: Defines a staging rollout/recovery trigger, UNREADY placeholder status, no execution claim, proposed per-step control-plane deadlines and the overall recovery clock.

Ordered preflight establishes trusted controller and Linux host context, pinned tools/configuration, actual account resolution, region, caller identity, host-key trust, site capabilities/ACLs and bounded immutable-artifact plans; mismatch, missing trust and drift stop mutations or dispatch.

Canary and isolated recovery steps specify expected health/durability/isolation, state reconciliation before retry, abort triggers, old-writer fencing, compatible restoration/rollback, data preservation and the 900-second stop condition.

checks.criterion: Tenant/replay/publication/recovery verification; accepted job is distinct from solver completion

evidence.finding: Acceptance follows durable commit rather than solver completion; cross-tenant access denial, replay-safe final publication and failure-onset recovery measurement have explicit acceptance descriptions and supporting ownership mechanisms.
Plans acknowledgement-crash, two-tenant denial, replay/concurrent publication/stale-owner, timed restore/queue/WAN and target-placement probes. Every probe is explicitly UNVERIFIED.

checks.criterion: 900 seconds is a target rather than achieved recovery; record is proportional and adds no approval ceremony

evidence.finding: R04 defines a proposed 900-second measurement, acknowledges the unresolved failure envelope and queue/restore delays, and makes expiry a failed-exercise stop condition. No achieved recovery is claimed.

One bounded record covers design and operation without separate required documents, exact-heading prescriptions, or an extra permission process. The unassigned reviewer and no-approval state remain explicit.

unverified.evidence: Lines 15 and 39 identify unknown implementation/environment and no executed probes or recovery measurement.

unverified.subject: Executable deployment/recovery readiness
unverified.evidence: Lines 15,25 and 29-35 retain unknown versions/resources/capabilities and explicitly UNREADY placeholders; the ordered procedure is a proposed authoring artifact.

unverified.subject: Exclusive one-file filesystem delivery
unverified.evidence: Only the assigned artifact was inspected; directory inventory was outside the four-file read scope. The inspected content itself is a single self-contained record.

limitations: The recovery failure envelope, recovery-point requirement, queue/restore delay and solver checkpoint capability must be resolved before meaningful operational acceptance; the record already exposes these uncertainties.
The design names authority and fencing mechanisms but supplies no resources, integration code or executable commands that could establish their correctness.
Documentation quality cannot establish runtime behavior, achieved recovery or implementation correctness.
